From Yellow Temperance · Price: integrated only; the slime eats anything that touches it, so allies avoid you.

Theme Affliction · Stand type integrated only

  • 1: Slime armor, always on while you're conscious (no action): resistance to physical damage equal to your level; creatures that hit you in melee take acid damage equal to your level. Also, 1 action: the slime lashes a creature within 20 ft: @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[acid]] (@Check[fortitude|against:stand|basic]{basic Fortitude}); on a failure it also takes 1d6 persistent acid and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 1}. Slime heals you for half the acid damage you deal with the lash and the engulf.
  • 5: Slime can take a disguise shape. Surge: slime engulfs a creature you grab: @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[acid]] (@Check[fortitude|against:stand|basic]{basic Fortitude}). The slime lash's persistent acid is 2d6.
  • 9: No change.
  • 13: The slime lash splits: it can target up to two creatures within 20 ft, and its persistent acid is 3d6.
  • 17: The resistance applies to all damage.

Effects @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-stand-class-archetype.stand-effects.Item.xp7q3A9lYiYbDwuU]{Effect: Slime Armor}

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
